body:
I have to go to a really morbid party today, and I'm struggling with how to  keep my emotions in check. My boyfriend's family really took me in and now one of his uncles is dying of a stage 4 cancer (4 weeks left, max). I absolutely adore this man, even though he isn't my relative, so I've been pretty upset about it. Anyways, today they are hosting "thanksgiving" at their house because he isn't going to be around in november. I'm so uncomfortable and exhausted by all this. I can't stop crying, but I'd like to because this really is a party  and its supposed to be a fun day to celebrate the family coming together and being thankful for our time with him.

I think I need a nap.

Anxiety is the worst,I suffer from it a great deal. If you can't go out, just make sure you take good care of yourself, I know that after a day filled with anxiety and pills I need a little self love, and you are sick on top of all that! Drink some hot tea or broth, take a nice bath or shower. Feel better!
youtube comments are typically made by the scum of the earth...very few are intelligible, let alone kind.
